name: restaurant-platform
description: Restaurant operations platform: orders at the table, tickets live in the kitchen, a bill at the end.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm migrate
scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.format: cargo fmt --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml && pnpm --filter web format
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml --check && pnpm --filter web format:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter infra typecheck
scripts.client:check: pnpm client:generate && git diff --exit-code api/openapi.json web/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
